status: Frozen before first execution; development experiment, not external preregistration
purpose: Learn a reusable residual correction without a clean donor at evaluation; compare downstream internal feedback, native task feedback, yoked and constant controls
model: Same hash-pinned quantized GPT-2 and graph adapter as Draft 5; no new download
source: results/gpt2-receiver-05/FAMILIES.json; book variants only, eight giver cases
heldout_templates: When {a} and {b} arrived at the museum, {s} gave a book to
After {a} and {b} finished the meeting, {s} handed a book to
At the library, {a} and {b} were reading. Then {s} passed a book to
Inside the cafe, {a} and {b} were talking. Later {s} offered a book to
split: Eight training cases in four old development families; sixteen newly specified evaluation cases in eight new families. All clean/corrupted variants remain in family. Evaluation starts only after training-state hashes are written. Similar grammatical task patterns are retained; this is not a new task domain.
subspace: Four orthonormal rows from training clean-minus-corrupt block-8 residual SVD. Center and coordinate scales use corrupted training states. Every policy receives the same teacher-derived subspace; task-feedback is not a teacher-free baseline.
features: u = R(h-mu)/scale, followed by a constant 1; B has 4x5 adaptive parameters initially zero
edit: h + R.T @ (scale * (B @ [u;1])); cap edit norm at twice median training donor-delta norm; cap B Frobenius norm at 4
learner: Coordinate sign search. At each training step query the actual decoder with B[j]+0.25 and B[j]-0.25, both constrained. Update the current B coordinate by 0.5 times sign(reward_plus-reward_minus), with a 1e-12 tie tolerance, then project to Frobenius radius 4. Coordinates cycle through 20 parameters. This is not a novel optimizer or a full LoReFT reproduction.
internal_feedback: Negative squared error of actual downstream attention-9 value tensor relative to the clean training tensor, normalized by its original clean/corrupt squared gap (minimum 1e-8)
task_feedback: Native full-vocabulary log probability of intended recipient, not a two-name softmax
external_matched: Separate controller receives exactly the same two measured scalar values per step; no internal-state access beyond common features and those scalars. No duplicate decoder calls are counted for identical feedback replay.
yoked: Receives internal-policy reward pair from the opposite-giver case in the same shuffled epoch; it does not receive feedback about its own proposed perturbation
constant: Both feedback values are 0, while its candidate interventions are still measured and logged
evaluation: No updates; native target probability, name contrast, unrestricted top token, edit norm, downstream error and virtual usefulness. Primary adapter arms cannot read the clean state; it supplies an oracle/control and post-hoc error only. Reloaded parameters and reset parameters are evaluated separately; base weights fixed.
authority: Signed feedback envelopes bind step, coordinate, source parameter digest and both rewards. Actual receiver validates signature, freshness, parameter digest, finite rewards and dimensions. Afterwards submit one replay and 40 forged coordinate-driving pairs to guarded/unverified cloned internal learners; compare actual post-attack model behavior. Public fixture key, not production security.
claim_limits: New adaptive parameters belong to an instrument-assisted controller; GPT-2 does not autonomously introspect
Equal queries do not imply equal feedback information
All policies share a clean-pair-derived subspace
One quantized checkpoint and eight evaluation families
Modern instruction-tuned and DeepSeek transfer remain open
Adverse and zero-improvement results must be retained
